abstract: The OECD Employment Outlook 2023 examines the impact of artificial intelligence on labor markets across OECD countries. The report finds that a significant proportion of jobs face automation risk, with implications for workforce displacement and labor market dynamics in the coming years.
keyFindings: 27% of jobs are in occupations at high risk of automation across OECD countries
